newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish WIG index seen at 15,996 end June.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish WIG index seen at 15,996 end June.

text.p: The main all-share WIG index of the Warsaw bourse is seen at just below 16,000 points at the end of this month, a Reuter poll of leading securities houses showed.
The average prediction for the blue-chip WIG20 index was 1,592.8 points.
Analysts predicted the main WIG index would reach 16.233.8 points at the end of July and saw it at about 20,000 points on June 30, 1998.
On June 5, the WIG closed at 15,818.1 points and the WIG20 at 1,588.1.

FORECASTS CONTRIBUTED BY: BDM PKO BP, DM PBG SA-Pekao SA Group, DB Bank Slaski SA, DM PBK SA, DM PBR SA, Creditanstalt Securities SA, Bank Zachodni SA, DM Penetrator, ING BSK Asset Management, COK Bank Handlowy SA, BM BGZ SA, BRE Brokers.
NOTE: The survey, the first of monthly polls, was conducted on June 2.
